title: Sri Lanka Grand Circle Tour
description: A complete circuit of Sri Lanka's ancient cities, hill country tea trails, and southern beaches — combining cultural landmarks, wildlife safaris, hiking, and coastal relaxation into one unforgettable journey.

itinerary.title: Colombo Airport → Sigiriya / Habarana
itinerary.desc: Pick up from Colombo airport and drive to Sigiriya, stopping on the way at Dambulla Cave Temple. Evening relax at the hotel. Overnight stay at Sigiriya or Habarana.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Lion Rock & Village Experience
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, hike up the Sigiriya Lion Rock (or explore around it if the climb is difficult). In the evening, enjoy a real village tour around the village and lake area — learning Sri Lankan cooking, having a local lunch, and a tuk tuk ride.

itinerary.title: Polonnaruwa & Minneriya Safari
itinerary.desc: Morning drive to Polonnaruwa to explore the ancient ruins and sites, then drive back to Habarana. At 2.30pm, safari at Minneriya National Park to see large herds of wild elephants. Overnight stay at Sigiriya or Habarana.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kandy
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Kandy, stopping at the Matale Hindu Temple and a herbal & spice garden. Optional: Kandy Lake and city. Evening Kandy cultural dance show (5.00pm). Overnight stay at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy → Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.desc: Morning visit to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, Kandy view point, and Peradeniya Botanical Garden (optional shopping in Kandy). Drive to Nuwara Eliya, visiting a wood carving factory, tea factory and tea plantations, and Ramboda waterfalls and viewpoints along the way. Overnight stay at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Scenic Train to Ella
itinerary.desc: Morning visit to Nuwara Eliya city, Gregory Lake, tea plantations, the Old Post Office building, and a boat ride at Gregory Lake. Drive to Ambewela to catch one of the most beautiful train rides in Sri Lanka to Ella, where your driver will meet you at the station. Evening dinner in Ella city. Overnight stay at Ella.

itinerary.title: Nine Arch Bridge → Yala / Thissamaharama
itinerary.desc: Morning trek to the Nine Arch Bridge (optional hike to Little Adam's Peak). Drive to Yala, stopping to visit Ravana Waterfall and trek to the Pallewela Waterfalls for a swim. Overnight stay at Yala or Thissamaharama.

itinerary.title: Yala Safari → Mirissa / Galle
itinerary.desc: Early morning safari (5.30am) at Yala National Park — one of the best wildlife experiences in Sri Lanka (approx. 4 hours, full-day option available). After a late or takeaway breakfast, check out and drive to Galle to relax on the beach. Overnight stay at Galle.

itinerary.title: Galle Beach & Dutch Fort
itinerary.desc: Morning relaxing on the beach. Evening visit to the Galle Dutch Fort (optional: sea turtle hatchery). Overnight stay at Galle.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Drive to Colombo airport for drop-off. End of the tour.

title: Cultural Triangle & Hill Country Express
description: An 8-day journey from Trincomalee through the Cultural Triangle to the cool hill country of Kandy and Nuwara Eliya, blending ancient heritage sites with wildlife safaris and tea-country scenery.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee → Sigiriya
itinerary.desc: Pick up from your hotel in Trincomalee and drive to Sigiriya, doing a safari at Minneriya National Park along the way. Evening relax at the hotel. Overnight stay at Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Lion Rock & Local Culture
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, hike the Sigiriya Lion Rock and explore its history. Optional: visit a local village to experience local culture, food, canyoning, Sri Lankan cooking, and a local lunch. Evening visit to the Dambulla Cave Temple, one of the finest UNESCO heritage sites in Sri Lanka. Overnight stay at Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Polonnaruwa → Kandy
itinerary.desc: Morning drive to Polonnaruwa to explore the ancient ruins, then drive back to Kandy. Optional stops at the Matale Hindu Temple and spice & herbal gardens along the way. Overnight stay at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy Heritage Day
itinerary.desc: Morning visit to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, Kandy view point, Kandy city and lake, and Peradeniya Botanical Garden. Evening Kandy cultural dance show (5.00pm). Overnight stay at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy → Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.desc: Drive to Nuwara Eliya by van, visiting a tea factory, tea plantations, and Ramboda waterfalls and viewpoints along the way. Overnight stay at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya City & Gardens
itinerary.desc: Morning visit to Nuwara Eliya city, Gregory Lake, tea plantations, Hakgala Botanical Gardens, and the Old Post Office building. Evening relaxing in Nuwara Eliya. Overnight stay at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Drive to Colombo
itinerary.desc: Drive to Colombo, stopping at two waterfall viewpoints along the way. Optional: white water rafting at Kitulgala. Evening relax at the hotel. Overnight stay at Colombo.

itinerary.title: Colombo City Tour & Departure
itinerary.desc: Morning Colombo city tour according to your preference. Evening drive to Colombo airport. End of the tour.

title: Grand Sri Lanka Explorer
description: An extensive 11-day private tour covering Sri Lanka's ancient capitals, cultural triangle, hill country tea trails, wildlife safaris, and the southern coast — the complete island experience for travellers with time to spare.

itinerary.title: Colombo Airport → Anuradhapura
itinerary.desc: Pick up from Colombo airport and drive to Anuradhapura (about 3.5 hours). Evening visit to the Anuradhapura historical site (remaining sites can be covered the next morning if needed). Overnight stay at Anuradhapura.

itinerary.title: Anuradhapura → Habarana
itinerary.desc: Morning exploring the rest of the Anuradhapura site, then drive to Habarana. Evening safari at Minneriya or Hurulu Eco National Park. Optional: Ayurvedic spa. Overnight stay at Sigiriya or Habarana.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock & Polonnaruwa
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, hike the Sigiriya Lion Rock, then drive to Polonnaruwa to explore its ancient ruins. Optional: evening trek to Pidurangala Rock, or a village tour with a homemade lunch (bullock cart ride, canyoning, Sri Lankan cooking, local lunch). Overnight stay at Sigiriya or Habarana.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kandy
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Kandy, visiting the Dambulla Cave Temple and Matale Hindu Temple along the way. Visit a herbal & spice garden and a wood carving factory. Optional: Kandy Lake and city. Evening Kandy cultural dance show (5.00pm). Overnight stay at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy → Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.desc: Morning visit to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, Kandy view point, and Peradeniya Botanical Garden (optional shopping in Kandy). Drive to Nuwara Eliya, visiting tea factories, tea plantations, and Ramboda waterfalls and viewpoints along the way. Overnight stay at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Scenic Train to Ella
itinerary.desc: Morning visit to Nuwara Eliya city, the Old Post Office building, Victoria Park, and a boat ride at Gregory Lake. Drive to Nanu Oya station to catch one of the most beautiful train rides in Sri Lanka to Ella (reserved tickets booked in advance). Evening dinner in Ella city. Overnight stay at Ella.

itinerary.title: Ella Tea Trail
itinerary.desc: Morning tea trail trekking or a visit to Lipton's Seat tea mountain. Evening relaxing at the hotel. Overnight stay at Ella.

itinerary.title: Little Adam's Peak & Yala / Thissamaharama
itinerary.desc: Hike Little Adam's Peak and trek to the Nine Arch Bridge. Drive to Yala, stopping at Ravana Waterfall along the way. Evening relax at the hotel. Overnight stay at Yala or Thissamaharama.

itinerary.title: Yala Safari → Galle
itinerary.desc: Early morning safari (5.30am) at Yala National Park, one of the best wildlife experiences in Sri Lanka. After a late or takeaway breakfast, check out and drive to Galle to relax on the beach. Overnight stay at Galle.

itinerary.title: Galle Fort & Coast
itinerary.desc: Morning enjoying the beach, evening visit to the Galle Dutch Fort. Optional: sea turtle farm and Madhu River boat safari. Relax on the beach. Overnight stay at Galle.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Drive to Colombo airport for drop-off. End of the tour.

title: Classic Sri Lanka & Bentota Beach
description: A relaxed 7-day introduction to Sri Lanka, combining Colombo's city sights, Kandy's cultural heart, the cool tea hills of Nuwara Eliya, and a restful finish on Bentota's beaches — ideal for a shorter getaway.

itinerary.title: Colombo City Tour
itinerary.desc: Pick up from Colombo airport and enjoy a Colombo city tour. Overnight stay at Colombo.

itinerary.title: Colombo → Kandy
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Kandy, visiting Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage or Millennium Elephant along the way. Visit Peradeniya Botanical Gardens. Optional: Kandy Lake, city, and a gem & jewellery factory. Evening Kandy cultural dance show (5.00pm). Overnight stay at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy → Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.desc: Morning visit to the Temple of the Tooth Relic and Kandy view point. Visit a wood carving facility (optional shopping in Kandy). Drive to Nuwara Eliya, visiting a tea factory and Ramboda waterfalls and viewpoints along the way. Overnight stay at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya City & Tea Country
itinerary.desc: Explore Nuwara Eliya city, the Old Post Office building, and Gregory Lake. Visit the Seetha Amman Temple. Visit tea plantations and enjoy the mountain views.

itinerary.title: Drive to Bentota
itinerary.desc: Drive to Bentota, stopping at waterfall viewpoints along the way. Optional: white water rafting at Kitulgala. Overnight stay at Bentota.

itinerary.title: Bentota Beach & Galle
itinerary.desc: Morning relaxation on the beach. Drive to Galle to see the Galle Dutch Fort, with an optional Madhu River boat safari or sea turtle hatchery visit along the way. Overnight stay at Bentota.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Pick up from Bentota and drive to Colombo airport. End of the tour.
